changes_from_warm_vs_cold_recipe_search_: targets: all six cells, all on window W3 (origins quoted from batch_recipe_windows_v1; W3 has never been a target)
budget: shortlist capped at 2, so 2 charged full-batch Support evaluations
criterion: the paired delayed difference decides the label; cost is reported separately and never folded in
instrument hardening: the adoption prompt enumerates every measured plan, identically for both arms
pre_registered.primary_readout: per target, the paired delayed difference delta = warm delayed aggregate gain minus cold delayed aggregate gain, both measured by the same instrument on the same window
pre_registered.cost_is_reported_separately: charged evaluations and LLM calls are reported per arm and never enter the label. WARM_ALSO_CHEAPER is recorded as a separate flag when the warm arm used strictly fewer charged evaluations and its delayed gain is not below the cold arm's
pre_registered.overall_verdict: the win / loss / tie count over the six targets, plus the worst target by paired delta, named explicitly. A pooled mean on its own is not an acceptable reading of this run
pre_registered.experience_isolation: the warm arm's corpus is the 18 frozen records only; every row this rotation produces is written to the artifact and to no episode's visible experience
pre_registered.circuit_breaker: stop and report if the first episode produces no adopted plan
